title: delegated_decisions rides the same request plane as external-operation grants
summary: Charter delegated_decisions (policy per business decision type) extends the authority request input, plan builder, read model and Concierge panel — validated against charter-decision-vocabulary delegable types; revoke deletes entries.
reusable_steps: Charter delegated_decisions (policy per business decision type) extends the authority request input, plan builder, read model and Concierge panel — validated against charter-decision-vocabulary delegable types; revoke deletes entries
expected_outcome: Pattern: a charter envelope field becomes user-editable by adding it to OnboardingAuthorityInput parse + buildPlan merge + readOnboardingAuthority output + one panel block.
